Welcome to tidyrethinking. This package refactors Statistical Rethinking teaching scripts into
reusable, tidyverse-style functions with Quarto vignettes.

- Composable, pipe-friendly APIs (data-first)
- Roxygen2 documentation and tests
- Quarto for vignettes and site docs
